Class Gltf

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.Gltf
public final class Gltf extends Object
A 3D model of glTF 2.0 (.glb or .gltf): the meshes (triangles with normals, texture coordinates, the base color and the texture of the material), the nodes, the skins and the animations (translation, rotation and scale of the nodes; linear, step and cubic spline interpolation). pose(int, double) returns the meshes of an animation at a time (skinned on the CPU) in the coordinates of the simulation: z up, the front of the model (+z of glTF) in the direction of +y, the model centered with its base at z = 0 and a height of 1.
